evidence: SponsorRadar records PECRON sponsoring Jasonoid's August 14, 2026 English-language YouTube video. Jasonoid has about 130K subscribers. PECRON sells tangible portable power stations, batteries, and solar hardware. PECRON's official ambassador/affiliate program explicitly recruits social media influencers and content creators and lists herman@pecron.com for deeper business collaboration; its official FAQ identifies Herman as the Marketing Manager for business and partnership inquiries.
